title: Agent.xpu: Efficient Scheduling of Agentic LLM Workloads on Heterogeneous SoC
authors: Xinming Wei; Jiahao Zhang; Haoran Li; Jiayu Chen; Haoning Guan; Rui Qu; Maoliang Li; Xiang Chen; Guojie Luo
affiliations: Peking University, The University of Hong Kong
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, LLM serving, Hardware co-design, PD disaggregation, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Personal LLM agents combine foreground reactive interactions with background proactive monitoring, forming long-lived stateful LLM flows that interleave prefill and decode with unpredictable concurrency. Commodity heterogeneous SoCs integrate CPU, iGPU, and NPU with shared DDR memory, but existing on-device engines assume static, single-shot inference and lack flow-level concurrency, prioritization, and accelerator coordination, leading to shared-memory contention, NPU/iGPU interference, and starving reactive flows.
problem_statement.zh: 個人 LLM agent 同時處理前景 reactive 互動與背景 proactive 監測，形成長時間有狀態的 LLM flow，prefill 與 decode 以不可預測的並發交錯。商用異質 SoC 整合 CPU、iGPU 與 NPU 並共用 DDR 記憶體，但現有 on-device 推論引擎假設靜態單次推論，缺乏 flow 層級的並發、優先級與加速器協調，導致共享記憶體競爭、NPU 與 iGPU 互相干擾，以及 reactive flow 被餓死。

key_innovation.en: Agent.xpu introduces five techniques on shared-memory hetero-SoCs: (i) a Heterogeneous Execution Graph (HEG) abstraction with profiling-guided latency/bandwidth annotations and elastic operator binding; (ii) flow-aware NPU/iGPU coordination with stage elasticity that decouples prefill (NPU) from decode (iGPU); (iii) fine-grained kernel- and iteration-level preemption with copy-free context switching via a double activation buffer; (iv) slack-aware piggybacking that opportunistically fills compute/bandwidth slack with proactive work; (v) reactive-first adaptive decode batching that admits all reactive requests unconditionally and piggybacks proactive ones up to a cap.
key_innovation.zh: Agent.xpu 在共享記憶體的異質 SoC 上提出五項技術：(i) Heterogeneous Execution Graph（HEG）抽象，攜帶 profiling-guided 的延遲與頻寬註解與彈性運算子綁定；(ii) flow-aware 的 NPU 與 iGPU 協同，採 stage elasticity 將 prefill 由 NPU 主導、decode 由 iGPU 主導；(iii) 細粒度 kernel 與 iteration 層級搶占，透過雙 activation buffer 實現 copy-free 上下文切換；(iv) slack-aware piggybacking，趁運算與頻寬閒置時段以 proactive 工作填充；(v) reactive-first 自適應 decode batching，無條件納入 reactive request 並以上限機制 piggyback proactive request。

key_improvements.en: 1.2-4.9x higher proactive throughput while reducing reactive latency by at least 91% (up to 97%); 0.3-58% throughput gain over OpenVINO (iGPU) with even larger gains over other baselines; energy consumption reduced 26.8% and iGPU utilization reduced 32.5% versus iGPU serving and serial NPU-iGPU baselines respectively.
key_improvements.zh: Proactive throughput 提升 1.2-4.9x，同時將 reactive 延遲降低至少 91%（最高 97%）；相較 OpenVINO（iGPU）throughput 提升 0.3-58%，相較其他 baseline 增益更大；相較 iGPU serving 與 serial NPU-iGPU 基線，能耗降低 26.8%、iGPU 利用率降低 32.5%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding
gpu_count: 1x Intel Arc iGPU + 1x Intel AI Boost NPU (single SoC)
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (predictive kernel annotation uses roofline + analytical model with stable per-kernel times across invocations; accuracy not quantified)
validation_workloads: ProactiveBench, SAMSum, CNN/DailyMail (proactive); LMSys-Chat-1M, MTRAG, Berkeley Function Call Leaderboard (reactive); Proactive-Mixed and Reactive-Mixed composites with Poisson arrivals 1-30 req/min

scope_assumptions.en: Targets shared-memory hetero-SoCs (CPU+iGPU+NPU) with unified DDR; evaluation on a single Intel Core Ultra 5 125H NUC. Uses W8A16 channel-wise quantization with negligible accuracy loss assumed. NPU kernels are AOT-compiled (cold-start JIT prohibitive); dynamic NPU kernels amortize JIT cost across layers and during slack. CPU is reserved for control flow, sampling, and kernel compilation only. Memory-overflow conditions are deferred to orthogonal offload techniques and not handled by Agent.xpu. Scope is on-device personal agents (1-30 req/min), not datacenter LLM serving.
scope_assumptions.zh: 目標為共享記憶體異質 SoC（CPU+iGPU+NPU）且使用統一 DDR；評估僅在單台 Intel Core Ultra 5 125H NUC 上進行。採用 W8A16 channel-wise 量化並假設精度損失可忽略。NPU kernel 採 AOT 編譯（冷啟動 JIT 不可行）；動態 NPU kernel 將 JIT 成本攤提到各層與閒置時段。CPU 僅保留給控制流、取樣與 kernel 編譯。記憶體溢位情境委由正交的 offload 技術處理，不在 Agent.xpu 範疇內。研究範圍限於 on-device 個人 agent（1-30 req/min），非資料中心 LLM serving。
